parts.problem_md:
Geri and Tom start a business together.

In the first year, the business makes a profit of \$127 600.
Geri receives $\frac{3}{8}$ of the profit.
Tom receives \$22 330 of the profit.
The rest of the profit is put into a bank account.

(i) Calculate how much money Geri receives.

\$ ............................................... [1]

(ii) Calculate the amount put into the bank account as a percentage of the profit.

............................................% [2]

(iii) Tom invests his \$22 330 at a rate of 3.2% per year compound interest. Calculate the value of this investment at the end of 5 years.

\$ ............................................... [2]
parts.solution_md:
(i)

Multiply \$127600 by $\frac{3}{8}$ to find how much Geri receives

$\frac{3}{8}\times127600=47850$

**Final answer:** **\$47 850**

**[B1]**

(ii)

Subtract the amounts Geri and Tom get from \$127600

$127600-47850-22330=57420$

So \$57420 is put in the bank account

To find that as a percentage of the profit

- divide it by the profit

$\frac{57420}{127600}$

**[M1]**

- and multiply by 100

$\frac{57420}{127600}\times100=45$

**Final answer:** **45%**

**[A1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **M1**: For `fraction numerator 127600 minus your space Geri space amount minus 22330 over denominator 127600 end fraction space open square brackets cross times 100 close square brackets` or equivalent.
> 
> **A1**: For 45.

(iii)

Find the percentage multiplier for a 3.2% increase

- After increasing by 3.2% you will have 103.2% of the original amount
- Divide by 100 to make into a decimal

$\frac{103.2}{100}=1.032$

With compound interest over 5 years, that increase happens 5 times

- so multiply 22330 by 1.032 to the power of 5

$22330\times1.032^{5}$

**[M1]**

Use your calculator to work that out

$=26138.8941...$

- This is a money question, so round to 2 decimal places
- The '4' in the third decimal place tells you to leave the '9' in the second decimal place unchanged

**Final answer:** **\$26 138.89**

**[A1]**

> **[mark-scheme]**
> **M1**: For `22330 cross times open parentheses 1 plus fraction numerator 3.2 over denominator 100 end fraction close parentheses to the power of 5` or equivalent.
> 
> **A1**: For 26100 or 26140 or 26139 or 26138.[89...].

parts.problem_md:
Kim invests £13000 at a rate of 10% per year simple interest.

Calculate the total value of his investment after five years.
parts.solution_md:
> *Using the correct formula*

- $P=13000$* is the initial amount*
- $r=10$* is the rate*
- $t=5$* is the amount of time*

$I=\frac{P\timesr\timest}{100}\,I=\frac{13000\times10\times5}{100}\,I=6500$

**[M1]**

> *Add the interest amount to the initial amount*

$6500+13000=19500$

`£ 19500`

**[A1]**

parts.problem_md: Explain why the compound interest rate eventually **always** returns a greater amount than simple interest?
parts.solution_md:
- **Simple interest adds the same amount every year**
- **Compound interest earns interest on the previous interest**

**[B1]**

parts.problem_md:
Sonia wants to invest \$5000 for 6 years.

Bank A pays compound interest at a rate of 3.5% per year. 
Bank B increases the \$5000 by 22% at the end of 6 years.

Which bank will give Sonia the most money at the end of 6 years and by how much? You must show all your working.

![qp18-0580-13-paper-1-may-2020-cie-igcse-maths](assets/001-qp18-0580-13-paper-1-may-2020-cie-igcse-maths.png)
parts.solution_md:
> *Bank A*

> *An increase of 3.5% means 103.5% of the original amount. Divide 103.5 by 100 to find the multiplier.*

> * *

$103.5\div100=1.035$

> * *

> *The multiplier will be applied 6 times, so multiply \$5000 by *$1.035^{6}$*.*

> * *

$5000\times1.035^{6}=6146.2766...$

**[1]**

> *Round to 2 decimal places (because it is money).*

> * *

`Bank space straight A space equals space $ 6146.28`

**[1]**

** **

> *Bank B*

> *An increase of 22% means 122% of the original amount. Divide 122% by 100 to find the multiplier.*

> * *

$122\div100=1.22$

> * *

> *Multiply \$5000 by the multiplier, 1.22.*

> * *

$5000\times1.22=6100$

* ***[1]**

`Bank space straight B space equals space $ 6100`

**[1]**

** **

> *Bank A will give Sonia the most money.*

> *Subtract the Bank B figure, \$6100, from the Bank A figure, \$6146.28 to work out how much more Bank A gives.*

> * *

$6146.28-6100=46.28$

> * *

**Bank ****A**** will give ****\$ 46.28**** more money**. **[1]**
